title: Preliminary Insights on Industry Practices for Addressing Fairness Debt
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement. It is a qualitative study based on interviews with software professionals about fairness debt and does not mention religion or faith.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study.
